name: Fill your basket: fair compensation paid to presenter under optimal play
payoff: largest basket sum minus second-largest basket sum (S_max - S_mid)
game_rules: 3 baskets, n turns, coins 1..n. Each turn Presenter chooses basket, Placer chooses coin.
verification: Two-sided decision bracket: placer forces >= a(n) and presenter caps <= a(n) (placer cannot force >= a(n) + 1)
